_comment: Capture manifest for the user manual's figures (docs/manual/images/).
Driven by scripts/capture_manual_figures.sh, which launches the app with
SWMMVIS_CAPTURE_MANIFEST pointed here. One launch per 'model' group.
Row fields: name (must match a live \figtodo), action (ActionCatalog id),
widget (objectName), window (grab the main window), page (sidebar/tab text),
tab (sub-tab after page), size (WxH), lane (offscreen|live|human), settleMs.
lane:'live' rows need a real display — scene-graph content reads back blank
under the offscreen platform. lane:'human' rows are native menus/pickers the
engine refuses to drive; they are listed in tests/manual/manual_figures/.

models._comment: Passed to the launcher as SWMMVIS_OPEN_ON_STARTUP, not read by the engine.

figures._note: Pin the tab. Without it the page inherits whichever tab a previous capture left current, which produced a greyed Finite Volume tab under a dynamic-wave model instead of the default Routing tab.

figures.name: t03_results_style_panel.png

Scrub to frame 112 of 480 (00:56:30 model UTC; native clock may show local previous-day time). Peak screenshot shows fixed range and velocity image adds the actual Flow Velocity sublayer. Reviewable sidecar: round7/bowl-surface-view/terrain_bowl.oswp.

figures.name: t03_raster_style.png
figures._note: Load terrain_bowl.asc with terrain_bowl.prj and terrain_bowl_domain.geojson; raster and model use EPSG:3857. Open the raster Symbology and enable relief shading. For Generate Mesh, select the raster and boundary polygon and enter a relative output path. This captures configuration, not a generated replacement mesh.

figures.name: t07_water_age_sources.png
figures._note: Prepare the portable transport fixture with all four component sidecars, run with the selected engine, then open Water Age Sources. Verify external inflow 0.5 h, initial network state 6 h and an empty per-node table before capture.
